lines.zh: 幽暗兽贴着阴影向前爬
lines.en: The gloom-creature crawls along the shadows.

lines.zh: 它的节肢敲地，节奏很碎
lines.en: Its legs tap out a broken rhythm.

lines.zh: 它的身体把光都吸进去
lines.en: Its body swallows the light.
It moves from dark to darker.

lines.zh: 它一步一停，像在嗅什么
lines.en: Step, pause, as if sniffing.

lines.zh: 它的轮廓在边缘处发虚
lines.en: Its outline blurs at the edges.
It rounds a pillar silently.

lines.zh: 它的影子比身体大一圈
lines.en: Its shadow is a size larger than it.
It moves in your direction.
Its motion is deeply unnatural.
It stops, then lurches forward.

lines.zh: 它贴着地面滑行了一小段
lines.en: It slides a short way along the ground.
It presses itself very low.

lines.zh: 它的每一步都被阴影接住
lines.en: Each step is caught by shadow.
It looks seeped out of the wall.

lines.zh: 它慢慢绕到你的另一侧
lines.en: It works around to your other side.

lines.zh: 幽暗兽伏着，几乎看不见
lines.en: The gloom-creature lies nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 只有眼睛那里有两点微光
lines.en: Only two faint points show at its eyes.
Its form swells and settles slightly.
Its limbs tuck beneath it.
It twitches suddenly.

lines.zh: 黑暗在它周围聚得更浓
lines.en: The dark thickens around it.
Its shape is hard to pin down.
It spreads itself wider.
The ground darkens beneath it.
It slowly lifts its head.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸没有一点声音
lines.en: Its breathing makes no sound.
It seems always to be waiting.
The gloom-creature raises its head to you.

lines.zh: 它的两点光挪到你身上
lines.en: Its two lights shift onto you.
Its two lights pass over you.

lines.zh: 它的轮廓在你眼里晃了晃
lines.en: Its outline wavers in your sight.
It does not move; it only stares.
It drifts slowly toward you.
Its limbs spread and retract.
It seems to smell your breath.
It circles your shadow.
There is no hesitation in it.

lines.zh: 它的身体散了一下，又聚回
lines.en: Its body scatters and re-forms.
Its two lights dim.
Its outline shakes badly.
It retreats, dragging a knot of shadow.
The black on the ground pulls back.
Its movements slow further.

lines.zh: 它发出一种极低的声音
lines.en: It makes a very low sound.

lines.zh: 它的身体边缘开始发散
lines.en: Its edges begin to fray.
It struggles to pull its shape back.
Its two lights come back on.

lines.zh: 它朝你手上的东西探过来
lines.en: It probes toward what you hold.
A limb touches it.

lines.zh: 它把东西按住，慢慢拖走
lines.en: It pins the item and drags it off.
It takes the item into the shadow.
It feeds slowly, head down.

lines.zh: 它吃完还留着一点气味
lines.en: A trace of smell lingers after.
It pokes back out to search.

lines.zh: 它对不合口的东西吐出来
lines.en: What it rejects, it spits out.
It keeps the rest beneath itself.
It settles low, as if sated.
You hit it and it hardly feels solid.

lines.zh: 它的身体一下散开又聚回
lines.en: It scatters and gathers again.

lines.zh: 你的手穿过了它的影子
lines.en: Your hand passes through its shadow.
It backs half a block and reforms.

lines.zh: 它的节肢刮过你的袖口
lines.en: Its limbs scrape your cuff.
After the knock, its sound drops lower.

lines.zh: 它把碰撞处的黑暗补上
lines.en: It fills the gap in its own dark.
It shifts and goes around you.
It shows no reaction.
It merely sinks back into shadow.
Two patches of dark draw together.

lines.zh: 它们的边沿开始融在一起
lines.en: Their edges begin to bleed together.
Two lights become one.

lines.zh: 周围的地面彻底黑下来
lines.en: The ground around goes fully black.
Something shifts slowly inside.
No sound, and no clear shape.
After a while they separate.
The light splits back into two.
Each sinks back to its corner.

lines.zh: 地上留下两处深色的痕
lines.en: Two dark marks remain on the ground.
It presses the item down into shadow.

lines.zh: 它用节肢把东西包起来
lines.en: Its limbs close over the item.

lines.zh: 东西在它身下看不见了
lines.en: It vanishes beneath the creature.

lines.zh: 它慢慢吸走能吸的部分
lines.en: It draws off whatever it can.
It spits out the rest.
It hauls the item into the dark.

lines.zh: 它的动作慢得让人难受
lines.en: Its slowness is unsettling.
It stuffs the prize into a crack.
It looks back at where it fed.
Then settles again.
Its two lights go fixed.

lines.zh: 黑暗从它身下往外铺开
lines.en: The dark spreads out from under it.
Its body suddenly swells.
Its limbs open one by one.
The light in the air drops a shade.
It leans toward you.
Sound is swallowed around it.

lines.zh: 它已经把你圈进阴影里
lines.en: It has folded you into its shadow.
Its outline starts to tremble.
It is in no rush to lunge.
It waits for you to step into the dark.
Its two lights come nearer.
The gloom-creature closes low.
It reaches its shadow to your feet.
It tries to come up behind you.

lines.zh: 它的身体一半隐在暗里
lines.en: Half its body stays hidden.

lines.zh: 你的光只能照到它一点
lines.en: Your light only finds part of it.
It narrows your exits bit by bit.
It makes half a circuit around you.
Its limbs tick on the ground.
It stops, as if calculating.

lines.zh: 它把你的位置记得很准
lines.en: It has your position exactly.

lines.zh: 黑暗压得你有点看不清
lines.en: The dark makes it hard to see.
It moves again, still that slow.

lines.zh: 它的节肢刺进你的护甲
lines.en: A limb stabs into your armour.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞在你身上，很沉
lines.en: Its body hits you, inexplicably heavy.
Its shadow wraps your feet.

lines.zh: 它咬了一口，几乎没声音
lines.en: It bites, almost silently.
Cold spreads across your skin.
A limb comes out of the dark.

lines.zh: 它退开时带走了一点光
lines.en: It withdraws, taking a little light.
The second strike is faster.
It draws you deeper into the shadow.
It scatters after the strike and reforms.
The dark in the corner moves.

lines.zh: 幽暗兽从影子里浮出来
lines.en: The gloom-creature floats out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 它的轮廓一点点变清楚
lines.en: Its outline firms by degrees.
Two faint lights appear.
The air cools a little.
It spreads itself and holds.
There is one more shadow on the ground.
It turns this way.
Its limbs test the ground.
Then it starts to creep forward.

lines.zh: 火照进来，它的边缘卷曲
lines.en: Firelight enters and its edges curl.
Falling scatters it into a sheet of shadow.
The water thins it out.
The blast tears it into pieces.
An arrow passes through, leaving a hole.
Odd force stirs its dark into chaos.
It fades thin as a film of ash.

lines.zh: 电光把它的形状照得一清二楚
lines.en: The flash shows its shape entirely.

lines.zh: 虚空吸走它，它几乎散尽
lines.en: The void draws it out until almost nothing is left.
